name: dk-guard
description: Deterministic guardrail hooks for agent sessions (Bash guard, worktree requirement on edits, SessionStart baseline, push gate), plus dk-gate to run a repo's gate and reuse a pass on the same tree, dk-pg for a throwaway Postgres per issue, dk-gc to remove what merged work left behind, dk-assets to push verify screenshots, and dk-comment-edit to correct a comment an agent posted. No skills, so it stays on while skills are switched off.
